[Intro]

[Verse 1]
[A#]You would not believe your eyes,
[G#]If ten million fireflies
[A#]Lit up the world as I fell asleep.
[G#]
[A#]'Cause they'd fill the open air,
[G#]And leave teardrops everywhere, You'd
[A#]think me rude, but I would just stand and
[G#]stare.

[Chorus]
[G#]I'd like to make [Eb/G]myself believe,
[D#5]That planet Earth
[G#][Eb/G]turns
[G#][A#]slowly... It's
[G#]hard to say that I'd [Eb/G]rather Stay awake,
[G#]when [A#]I'm asleep, [Cm]'Cause
[G#]everything is [Eb/G]never as it seems...
[F/A]  [A#sus4]

[Verse 2]
[A#]'Cause I'd get a thousand hugs
[G#]From ten thousand lightning bugs,
[A#]As they tried to teach me how to
[G#]dance!
[A#]A foxtrot above my head,
[G#]A sockhop beneath my bed, A dis-
[A#]co ball is just hanging by a
[G#]thread!

[Chorus]
[G#]I'd like to make [Eb/G]myself believe,
[D#5]That planet Earth
[G#][Eb/G]turns
[G#][A#]slowly... It's
[G#]hard to say that I'd [Eb/G]rather Stay awake,
[G#]when [A#]I'm asleep, [Cm]'Cause
[G#]everything is [Eb/G]never as it seems...
[F/A](When I [A#sus4]fall asleep)

[Verse 3]
[A#]Leave my door open just a crack,
[G#](Please take me away from
[A#]here) 'Cause I feel like such an insomniac,
[G#](Please take me away from
[A#]here) Why do I tire of counting
[G#]sheep, (Please take me away from
[A#]here) When I'm far too tired to fall asleep!
[G#]
[A#]To ten million fireflies
[G#]I'm weird 'cause I hate goodbyes,
[A#]I got misty eyes as they said fare-
[G#]well...
[A#]But I'll know where several are,
[G#]If my dreams get real bizarre, 'Cause
[A#]I saved a few and I keep them in a
[G#]jar!
